title: 着脱式スチールボラード
description: 反射帯、鍵穴、持ち上げループ、基礎ソケットを備える着脱式の車止め。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A removable powder-coated steel bollard with socket collar, lift loop, lock and reflector bands. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner's request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.
